hook: Your flight from Paris can land in a French island across the world.
title: Fly From Paris, Land in France 12 Hours Away
description:
France has more time zones than any other country because of its overseas territories. Paris to French Polynesia is a 12 hour time difference in summer. Part of the series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Geography #France
comment_prompt: Would you fly it? Yes or no
